chunks.head: next to
chunks.gloss: 几乎；差不多(接形容词/名词)
chunks.note: next to + 形容词/名词,表示“几乎、差不多”,常用于极端或否定义,如 next to nothing / next to impossible。

literal.note_cn: 此处引申为“几乎”,非“下一个”

chunks.ex_en: The old bike is worth next to nothing now.
chunks.ex_cn: 那辆旧自行车现在几乎一文不值。

chunks.head: rake up
chunks.note: rake up 原指用耙子把东西聚拢,引申为重新提起(往往是不愉快的)旧事。
chunks.ex_en: Why rake up old quarrels that everyone has forgotten?
chunks.ex_cn: 何必重提大家早已忘记的旧争吵?

chunks.head: in strict confidence
chunks.gloss: 极为秘密地;私下里(告知)
chunks.note: confidence 此处指“秘密”;in (strict) confidence 表示告诉某事时要求对方严格保密。
chunks.ex_en: She told me in strict confidence that she was leaving.
chunks.ex_cn: 她私下悄悄告诉我她要离职了。

chunks.head: straight off
chunks.note: 口语,意为“马上、立即”,强调没有耽搁、不假思索。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 straight 构成习语“立刻”

chunks.ex_en: He knew the answer straight off.
chunks.ex_cn: 他一下子就知道了答案。

chunks.head: look to it that
chunks.note: see/look to it that + 从句 = 务必保证某事做到。
chunks.ex_en: Look to it that the door is locked before you leave.
chunks.ex_cn: 走之前务必确保门锁好。

chunks.head: hand and foot
chunks.note: bound hand and foot = 手脚都被捆住,喻完全受束缚、动弹不得;另有 wait on sb hand and foot(无微不至伺候)。本章为前者。
chunks.ex_en: The robbers tied him hand and foot and left.
chunks.ex_cn: 强盗把他手脚捆住就走了。

chunks.head: turn up
chunks.note: turn up = (人或物)出现、露面,常含意外或未事先安排之意。本章 “turned up missing” 是美式口语,字面“现身却是缺席”,即“(某人)忽然不见了”。
chunks.ex_en: He finally turned up an hour late.
chunks.ex_cn: 他终于露面了,迟到了一个小时。

chunks.head: high and low
chunks.note: 常与 search/hunt/look 连用,表示彻底地、到处地寻找。
chunks.ex_en: I searched high and low for my keys.

chunks.head: odds and ends
chunks.note: 固定搭配,指各种零散的小物件或剩余的东西。
chunks.ex_en: The drawer was full of odds and ends.
chunks.ex_cn: 抽屉里装满了各种零碎杂物。

chunks.head: be used to
chunks.note: be used to + 名词/动名词 = 习惯于某事;注意与 used to do(过去常做)区分。
chunks.ex_en: I'm used to getting up early.

chunks.head: can't stand
chunks.note: stand 此处意为“忍受”,非“站立”;常用于讨厌或难以承受的人或事。本章 Huck 反复抱怨富家生活 can't stand it。
chunks.ex_en: I can't stand the smell of cigarettes.

chunks.head: take an interest in
chunks.note: take an interest in sth = 对某事感兴趣、上心。本章 Huck 用否定式(对吃食提不起兴趣)。
chunks.ex_en: She takes a great interest in painting.

chunks.head: what it's cracked up to be
chunks.gloss: (不)像人们所说的那么好;名(不)副实
chunks.note: be cracked up to be = 被吹捧成;常用否定 not what it's cracked up to be,表示“并不像传说的那么好”。本章 Huck 说“有钱并不像人们吹的那么好”。
chunks.ex_en: The famous restaurant was not what it's cracked up to be.
chunks.ex_cn: 那家名餐厅并不像人们说的那么好。
occ: what it’s cracked up to be

chunks.head: come to do sth
chunks.note: come to + 动词原形 = 逐渐变得...、开始...,强调一个渐进的过程。
chunks.ex_en: In time you'll come to enjoy your new job.
chunks.ex_cn: 过段时间你会渐渐喜欢上新工作。

chunks.head: stick to
chunks.note: stick to sth = 坚持某事、不改变;也指遵守、紧跟不放。
chunks.ex_en: Whatever happens, stick to your plan.
chunks.ex_cn: 不管发生什么,都要坚持你的计划。

chunks.head: let up on
chunks.note: let up = 减弱、放松;let up on sb = 对某人不再那么严厉。本章 Tom 答应求寡妇对 Huck 松一松。
chunks.ex_en: Let up on the poor kid—he's doing his best.
chunks.ex_cn: 别再为难那可怜的孩子了,他已经尽力了。

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.note: stand by sb = 在困难时支持、不离弃某人;另有“待命”之义。本章指盗匪帮众互相支持。
chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand by you in hard times.
chunks.ex_cn: 真正的朋友会在困境中支持你。

chunks.head: turn out to be
chunks.note: turn out (to be) = 事情或人最终被证明是...、结果如何。
chunks.ex_en: The stranger turned out to be my father's old friend.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个陌生人原来是我父亲的老朋友。
